dict.string: Fernlet uses your local network to connect with nearby trainers and friends for workout sharing.
Fernlet uses Ultra Wideband to precisely measure distance when connecting with a nearby trainer or friend.
Fernlet uses your camera to scan nutrition labels and to take photos during in-person sharing sessions.
Fernlet accesses your photo library to scan nutrition labels from saved photos.
Fernlet saves the shared pictures you choose after a friend session.
Fernlet uses Face ID to unlock your private health data.

Fernlet reads selected Health data only when you enable it — including workouts, body metrics, sleep, recovery, and (optionally) cycle data — to give you a complete, on-device picture of your wellbeing.
Fernlet writes the workouts and health observations you explicitly log into Apple Health, so they appear in Apple Fitness and across your devices.
Fernlet uses your approximate location only to check the weather for gentle recovery prompts, when you turn that on.
